create_segment: create a Segment NamedTuple with start, end, and optional src_id fields
create_segment_with_src_id: create a Segment with a start time, end time, and source identifier string
delta_segment: apply start and end deltas to a Segment and return a new shifted Segment
delta_segment_validation: validate that a delta operation does not produce an invalid segment where start exceeds end
review_segment_class: review the Segment NamedTuple class and its delta method for time range manipulation
